items.text: [p align="start"]Crisp leaves, warm kitchens, and the smell of something delicious is drifting through Kilima Village... Fall's Faire: Hearty Homecoming has arrived! Gather your closest friends for a new group quest with Sifuu, Hassian, Taylin, and Ulfe, then pull up a chair at the Bulletin Board and help Jina whip up A Feast for Thought. Press play on a brand-new retro Lunar Path: Path of the Classics, welcome the Corgi to your Ranch, and cozy-up your home with fresh Simple Sundries Decor, Gardening Inspired Tints, and Plushes. And the Premium Store is dialing up the nostalgia with a Vaporwave Glider, the Amber Heights Landscape, and much more. So get comfy with a warm cup of coffee (or tea!) and good company, because it's good to be home!

notes.title: A Secret Skate Spot in the Tower

items.text: [p align="start"]Rumor has it there's something rad tucked away behind the Tower.

[p align="start"]Step up to a board rack in the Skatepark, strap in, and prepare to kickflip into hyperdrive: you'll go whole hog as a Trufflet on wheels, ready to grind rails, launch off ramps, and chain together gnarly combos. Your skater will be a totally random Trufflet pulled straight from your Ranch (even retired Trufflets are back to shred!).

[p align="start"]Ready to paint the town? Any skater in the park can trigger an intense Red vs. Blue turf war by popping open a can of paint. Grab a matching Red or Blue board next to the cans and tear up the park! Every sick trick tags your team's color for ultimate bragging rights. But watch your back… the rival crew can hijack your turf by pulling off even wilder, higher-scoring tricks. After three minutes, whichever crew covered the most turf takes home the crown.
[p align="start"]Wanna customize your ride? Slap a radical sticker on your board to flaunt your vibe, or tag key spots all over the park to mark your domain.

[p align="start"]“The skate park was a gnarly experiment that stretched over two different hack-a-thons we did for the studio. We had a ton of fun playing around with it and stretching some capabilities of Palia and thought it would be a very fun (and very unserious) thing to share with Palians. That said, it is still an experiment at its core and that will show as you play; there are rough edges, and there are bugs. Because this was a side project, we felt it best to dedicate our attention to other core additions to Palia while letting you all have some fun with the feature. We currently don’t have any plans to expand this (or fix it) beyond what it is unless players are really loving it. So go shred it up and have some fun with your fellow Palians!” - S6 Forseti

items.text: [p align="start"]As the nights grow longer and moonlight settles over Kilima Village, a familiar kind of mischief stirs… Spiritfest returns in Fall’s Faire: Frights & Delights, bringing plenty of tricks, treats, and delightfully spooky surprises! Pay a visit to the Spooky Moon Store, stock up on Ectoplasm, Tattered Cloth, and other eerie essentials, lend Elouisa a hand at the Bulletin Board, and brave the newest Lunar Path: Path of the Ghastly. Give your home a little Spiritfest makeover with coffins, gargoyles, bottled poison, new Coven and Candy Corn Tints, spooky Plushes, and plenty more; then welcome the Palcat to your Ranch, and grow even closer with Sifuu, Hassian, Taylin, and Ulfe. And, of course, the Premium Store is getting dressed up for the occasion with Devilish Imp, Casual Cutie, Fungi Forager, the Palcat Rogue, Haunted Hollow Landscape, and more frighteningly fun additions. So light the candles, grab a friend, and follow that mysterious rustling in the pumpkin patch. Something wonderfully spooky is waiting in the dark!

[p align="start"]The Veil is thinning... Spiritfest has crept back into Kilima Village, and this year, we’re celebrating with a few new tricks along with the treats.

[p align="start"]The Spooky Moon Store is open for business, stocked with all the delightfully questionable Decor your Home Plot could possibly need: coffin beds, gargoyles, bottled poison (!?!?!), and even a bat roost that sends its residents fluttering when you wander past.

[p align="start"]You may also notice a couple of strange new materials turning up around the world of Palia during the event. Ectoplasm can appear as a rare bonus when gathering any forageable, and has all the gooey texture of melted marshmallow… but with considerably less appeal (to most). Tattered Cloth, meanwhile, can be collected from the prowling Ghastly Jaakcats, a type of spectral Jaakcat with little interest in being friendly. Bring both Ectoplasm and Tattered Cloth to the Bulletin Board and put your Spiritfest finds to good use.

[p align="start"]Spiritfest runs for a limited time only, so gather what you will while the haunts are fresh through the end of October (independent of patch cycles).
[p align="start"]Elouisa ain’t afraid of no ghosts! Help her track down the spectral scoundrel terrorizing Kilima by contributing requested items through the Bulletin Board.
[p align="start"]Complete the Bulletin Board to earn L’il Ghosties, a cluster of tiny, easily-trodden-on spectres that will also become available from the Spooky Moon Store.

[p align="start"]Finish the Outro quest and you’ll also receive a Spooky Moon Token, an especially rare Spiritfest currency, with only one available to earn each Spiritfest celebration. Choose how you spend it carefully... very carefully. For exactly what that means, see New Player Titles below.
[p align="start"]Four new Spiritfest Player Titles have arrived, but there’s a frightful little catch.

[p align="start"]The Vampire, The Werewolf, and The Witch can be claimed from the Spooky Moon Store using a Spooky Moon Token. But with only one Token available to earn each year, you’ll need to choose your creature carefully. Claim one, and the other two will slip back into the shadows.

items.text: [p align="start"]As crisp air settles and golden leaves begin to fall, a season of grand adventures, warm hearths, and new beginnings await you in Fall’s Faire: Petals & Portraits! Gather with fellow Palians to rebuild Kilima's beloved docks, discover a new Villager Friendship, and set off on an epic journey with the latest Lunar Path, Path of the Great Sage. Welcome the majestic Valhäst to your ranch, and transform your home into a royal retreat with the Queen Ushindi Home Line, delicious kitchen decor, and other cozy autumn touches. Celebrate your accomplishments with Player Titles, frame every perfect moment with Free Cam Photo Mode, and bundle up with charming new plushes. Fall into fantastic fashion with Premium Store additions like Winged Warrior, Sweater Weather, Valhäst, Clouded Toolskins, the Flying Nimbus Emote, and more. A bountiful new season has arrived, and your next adventure is waiting just beyond the falling leaves.
[p align="start"]Here's a snapshot of the new gameplay content coming to Patch 0.206:
All hands on deck for Palia’s first Civic Project! Pitch in with all Palians to help rebuild Kilima’s beloved docks together! 🔨
Every great story begins with hello. A new Villager Friendship is ready to discover! 💛
Adventure leaps to new heights in the Path of the Great Sage Lunar Path! 🐒
Give your home the royal treatment with the new Queen Ushindi Home Line! 👑
Make your mark! Player Titles are here with a new way to show off your accomplishments and personality! 🎖️
The Valhäst spreads its wings as Palia's newest mount and ranching companion! 🪽
Help Zeki pull off his latest scheme in the newest Bulletin Board! 🥸
Strike every pose with the new Free Cam and Photo Filters in Photo Mode! 📷
Bring the heat with delicious new decor made for your dream kitchen! 🍽️
Cozy up your collection with several adorable new plush additions! 🧸
Chic and on fleek! Frame your fabulous face with the all new Eyebrow and Eyelash customization feature! 🪞
Fall into fantastic fashion with Premium Store arrivals like Winged Warrior, Sweater Weather, Valhäst, Storage Enhancements, Clouded Toolskins, Flying Nimbus Emote, and more! 🍂

[p align="start"]Palia’s first-ever Civic Project has arrived! The Civic Project: Docks calls on all Palians to contribute items that help shape the world of Palia and rebuild the Kilima Docks. Kick things off by speaking with Ashura to help rebuild the harbor, establish a route to the Royal Highlands, and strengthen trade relationships!

[p align="start"]Contribute Building Supplies and Donation Kits at workbenches placed around the area, or from the comfort of your own Home Plot. Donation kits can be created from various skills, with each kit contributing 1, 2, or 4 points toward the community’s shared progress while also earning you Civic Project XP.
[p align="start"]Some kits will ask for specific collections, like 12 of the same uncommon insect, so be sure to keep an eye on the requirements!

[p align="start"]As for rewards? Your Civic Project XP can be used to unlock a huge variety of goodies, including recipes for new Kitchen Decor, Tailor Tickets, Treat Bags, Kilima Coins, Tints, Profile Icons, the Valhäst, and so much more.

[p align="start"]While the Civic Project: Docks rewards are found under the Lunar Path tab, they're part of their own project and do not need to be activated to participate. Even after the community finishes rebuilding the docks, you'll be able to continue earning Civic Project XP and unlocking every reward at your own pace.

[p align="start"]Your contributions can also earn you two special player titles before the docks are complete: one at 10 points and another at 400 points. Once construction is complete, these limited-time titles will no longer be available, making them a special memento for Palians who helped contribute to Palia's very first Civic Project.

[p align="start"]As milestones are reached, watch the docks come to life, transforming from a construction site into a bustling harbor for all Palians to enjoy, complete with a brand new route to the Royal Highlands.
[p align="start"]Let’s build something that every Palian can be proud of!

[p align="start"]“We’ve been wanting to create these game-wide objectives for a long time, and we’re incredibly excited to see the community come together to complete their first Civic Project. We built the vast majority of rewards for this project to be accessible to all players; however we saved the last few rewards for the truly die-hards who want to show off and give something for the very few to continue to pursue. Trust us when we say it’s ok to tap out!” -S6 Forseti
[p align="start"]Spoilers for post-‘The Lion and the Lamb’ content ahead: If you haven't completed the story through The Lion and the Lamb, you may want to skip this section to avoid spoilers.

[p align="start"]The story of the Beast of the Elderwood continues with the first four Friendship Levels for Taylin. Returning home after so many years isn't easy, and rebuilding relationships with her family proves to be its own challenge. It's up to you to help mend old bonds and bring this family closer together.

[p align="start"]This is only the beginning of their stories. Friendship Level 5 for members of this family will arrive over the next few patches. If you'd like to jump into those quests as soon as they arrive, be sure to also reach Friendship Level 4 with Ulfe, Hassian,, and Sifuu so you can dive right into the next chapter. And keep your eyes peeled... romance is also on the horizon for Taylin and Sifuu!
[p align="start"]Set off on an epic journey with our newest Lunar Path: Path of the Great Sage!
[p align="start"]Inspired by the legends, this path is packed with regal rewards, from mystical outfits to new pieces of the Queen Ushindi Home Line.
[p align="start"]Here are some of the rewards waiting for you on the Path of the Great Sage:
The Travellers Graphic Tee and Pants

[p align="start"]With 40 levels of rewards, this is one of our biggest Lunar Paths yet! The Path of the Great Sage is 1,975 Palia Coins for the Premium Upgrade, but as always, the free path is free, so everyone can embark on the journey.

[p align="start"]While riding a Valhäst, everyone in your party will also enjoy an improved turn rate, making it easier to stick together as you explore.

[p align="start"]After hearing just how successful the Daiya’s were in the Bahari Province Faire last year, Zeki has decided it’s time for him to cash in. There’s just one problem: he was banned from running a booth after a few… questionable business decisions.
[p align="start"]Help gather supplies for his disguise, game booths, prizes, and more, and you’ll earn four new wallpapers for your efforts. Check out the Wallpaper section below for more details!
[p align="start"]Strike your best pose from every angle with our newly added Free Camera mode!

[p align="start"]With Free Camera, you can now “fly” around your surroundings to line up the perfect shot from about any angle. You can zoom out up to 30 meters, so while you can’t quite reach the moon, you can still get pretty far! Just toggle Freecam directly from your camera.

[p align="start"]We're also adding two new Photo Filters to the Home Tours Store: Black & White and Golden Hour! Once unlocked, you can use them any time in Camera Mode to give your photos a little extra pizzazz!
[p align="start"]New angles, new perspectives, and even more ways to take your perfect screenshot!
Left Stick / WASD: Move forward, backward, left, and right
Hold Ctrl (PC): Slow movement for more precise positioning
D-Pad Left & Right / Z & X: Roll camera left and right
D-Pad Up & Down / Scroll Wheel: Adjust Field of View
A / Left Click: Take a picture

[p align="start"]Joining your fellow Palians just got easier! World IDs are a new way to join the same server as another Palian, even if you aren’t already in the same party or Friends List connections.

[p align="start"]From the Settings menu, you can access your current World ID, a short four-character code that can be copied and shared with other players. Anyone with the code can join your game World.

[p align="start"]The World ID menu also displays the World Age, so you can see how long the World has been active before sharing your code. If a World is full, expired, or otherwise unavailable, you won’t be able to join it using its World ID.
[p align="start"]Joining a Palian's World also follows standard fast-travel rules, meaning it will either use your available travel cooldown or consume a Travel Potion.

[p align="start"]For privacy, your World ID is hidden by default and only appears when you intentionally reveal it. Keep in mind that anyone with your World ID may be able to join your World while the code remains valid, so be mindful of where you share it.
[p align="start"]We're hoping World IDs makes it even easier for you to connect with other Palians and make memories together.

Hello, everyone! We hope that everyone has been enjoying Palia’s Steam Launch and the 0.178 update! But we also want to talk about some feedback that’s been brought to our attention.

notes.title: Palia is Currently in Open Beta

items.text: We want to clear the air: since our Open Beta launch back in August 2023, the game remains as a title still in Open Beta. Know that we’ll keep our players updated with as much information as possible as we approach what we consider to be our official launch.

We know that there has been feedback regarding our messaging and status on various platforms, but the emphasis is that Palia is free-to-play and available for anyone to try. It is a continuous, ongoing effort, and we are committed to providing patch updates with new content, improvements, and bug fixes well into the future.

In fact, looking at our version, being on 0.178 means we’ve made over 178 updates to the game! Even from the start, and the days of Pre-Alpha, we made sure to include player feedback and have it shape Palia to be where it is today. And when it’s ready, we also plan to have the versioning update from “0.XXX” to “1.XXX” to better reflect Palia’s new status — but even that is not the end. We’ll keep having more patches after, and developing Palia alongside our players. That was one of the primary reasons why we wanted it to be a free-to-play, live-service game.
We invite everyone to be part of this journey.
There’s some exciting content we’ve outlined in our March Dev Update, and some we’re not quite ready to share just yet as they need a bit more time to bake.

To our players, your feedback and support of the game will keep shaping and improving Palia. This is something we extend to all players: new, old, and returning.
